**Have I told you about that time when I ended up in a desert island?**

I woke up covered in sand, breathing was difficult and I had to use salty water to remove the sand from my mouth. That was a mistake, you don't want to be thirsty on a desert island. I got up and observed my surroundings, there was a large amount of vegetation and a row of trees extended as far as the eye could see to both sides and the breeze caused them to swing slowly from side to side. The sea was calm but I could still hear the sound of the waves in the distance.

No matter how hard I tried I couldn't remember how I ended up here but that was not the important thing now, I had to find some food and water. If I had learnt something from the movies is that I could get some water from those coconuts, the food was going to be a problem though and finally I was also in need of a place to sleep.

For the first time I decided to look to the front of the island, behind the trees, it was dark and in absolute silence, I felt observed but I was frozen, the fear didn't let me move. I spent some time there, staring at the dark side of the island, observing, waiting for something to happen. Suddenly something moved behind the bushes, the fear made my legs tremble, I grabbed a rock that was partially covered in sand next to me and approached the bush. It jumped out of the blue and run away, what was it?

The sound of the waves caught my attention again, this time it was stronger. I turned around again, the sea was still calm but there was something new on the beach. It was a box, there was a note attached to the box but the water has damaged it so much that I wasn't able to read it. Inside the box there was another note, this one wasn't damaged.

**"Sometimes you will feel alone, sometimes you will think that nobody likes you but never forget this: no man is an island"**

I turned around and looked at the trees, something moved behind the bushes again, I smiled, this time it was not dark, I could see a light in the distance, I knew they were waiting for me. I threw the gun as far as possible into the sea, I gave myself another chance, my lovely family was waiting for me in our beautiful home at the beach.
